purpose: pre-performance production-path alignment audit for the IWD/VBR value-role continuation
prior_method: restart all portfolios from cash on 2004-01-30 common window
new_method: preserve the full frozen V11 path; use original S&P role returns before substitution and value-ETF adjusted-close returns afterward
substitution_start_reason: a continuous hybrid realized-return path needs a prior VBR adjusted close; 2004-01-30 is the first VBR quote, so the next trading session is the first date on which a VBR close-to-close return is defined
calendar_alignment: last ETF adjusted close is carried forward on union-calendar dates without a new ETF quote; the role return on such a date is zero and the next quoted session realizes the full close-to-close return
candidate_set_policy: both IWD and VBR are retained because the predecessor trial preregistered both; no winner-only continuation is allowed
target_path_policy: V11 source full target fingerprint must remain ba67c8aa24bc7168; candidate execution-event target fingerprints must equal the source execution-event target fingerprint
portfolio_constraints: target gross <=1.0, non-negative weights, no financing, no shorting
